INSERT INTO EXPENSE (EXPENSE_ID, EMPNO, RECEIPT_URL, EXPENSE_DATE, AMOUNT, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, STATUS, OCR_RAW, OCR_HASH, CREATED_AT) VALUES (EXPENSE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empno}, #{receiptUrl}, TO_DATE(#{expenseDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{amount}, #{description}, #{category}, 'PENDING', #{ocrRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{ocrHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
SELECT EXPENSE_SEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT e.EXPENSE_ID, e.EMPNO, m.ENAME, e.RECEIPT_URL, TO_CHAR(e.EXPENSE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPENSE_DATE, e.AMOUNT, e.DESCRIPTION, e.CATEGORY, e.STATUS, e.OCR_RAW, e.CREATED_AT, e.CONFIRMED_BY, e.CONFIRMED_AT FROM EXPENSE e LEFT JOIN EMP m ON m.EMPNO = e.EMPNO WHERE e.EMPNO = #{empno} ORDER BY e.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT e.EXPENSE_ID, e.EMPNO, m.ENAME, e.RECEIPT_URL, TO_CHAR(e.EXPENSE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPENSE_DATE, e.AMOUNT, e.DESCRIPTION, e.CATEGORY, e.STATUS, e.OCR_RAW, e.CREATED_AT, e.CONFIRMED_BY, e.CONFIRMED_AT FROM EXPENSE e LEFT JOIN EMP m ON m.EMPNO = e.EMPNO WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.EXPENSE_DATE) = #{year} AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.EXPENSE_DATE) = #{month} ORDER BY e.EXPENSE_DATE DESC, e.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE EXPENSE SET STATUS = 'CONFIRMED', CONFIRMED_BY = #{confirmedBy}, CONFIRMED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE EXPENSE_ID = #{expenseId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM EXPENSE_MONTHLY_STAT WHERE STAT_YEAR = #{year} AND STAT_MONTH = #{month}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXPENSE_MONTHLY_STAT (STAT_ID, STAT_YEAR, STAT_MONTH, EMPNO, TOTAL_AMOUNT, EXPENSE_COUNT, CREATED_AT) SELECT EXPENSE_MONTHLY_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{year}, #{month}, EMPNO, SUM(AMOUNT), COUNT(*), SYSDATE FROM EXPENSE WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM EXPENSE_DATE) = #{year} AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM EXPENSE_DATE) = #{month} GROUP BY EMPNO
mapper.select: SELECT ROWNUM AS STAT_ID, t.* FROM ( SELECT #{year} AS STAT_YEAR, #{month} AS STAT_MONTH, e.EMPNO, m.ENAME, SUM(e.AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, COUNT(*) AS EXPENSE_COUNT, SYSDATE AS CREATED_AT FROM EXPENSE e LEFT JOIN EMP m ON m.EMPNO = e.EMPNO WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.EXPENSE_DATE) = #{year} AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.EXPENSE_DATE) = #{month} GROUP BY e.EMPNO, m.ENAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXPENSE_YEARLY_STAT (STAT_ID, STAT_YEAR, EMPNO, TOTAL_AMOUNT, EXPENSE_COUNT, CREATED_AT) SELECT EXPENSE_YEARLY_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{year}, EMPNO, SUM(AMOUNT), COUNT(*), SYSDATE FROM EXPENSE WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM EXPENSE_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY EMPNO
mapper.select: SELECT ROWNUM AS STAT_ID, t.* FROM ( SELECT #{year} AS STAT_YEAR, e.EMPNO, m.ENAME, SUM(e.AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, COUNT(*) AS EXPENSE_COUNT, SYSDATE AS CREATED_AT FROM EXPENSE e LEFT JOIN EMP m ON m.EMPNO = e.EMPNO WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.EXPENSE_DATE) = #{year} GROUP BY e.EMPNO, m.ENAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC ) t
